sentences.text: Katheryn Elizabeth Hudson -LRB- born October 25 , 1984 -RRB- , known professionally as Katy Perry , is an American singer and songwriter .
After singing in church during her childhood , she pursued a career in gospel music as a teenager .	gospel music	gospel music
